caption: The video showcases two stationary LED-wrapped palm trees glowing against a dark night background, with shrubbery below and a small plant at the right edge. A white chase climbs the left trunk while its fronds mix red and white lights. The right tree transitions from white and blue to solid blue. The left trunk remains red with the white chase near the top while the right tree stays blue. Red lights then take over the right tree's trunk and fronds, replacing the blue. The left tree continues to show red and white lights, while the right tree glows red with some blue accents on the fronds.
